scenes.title: Move food through hotter and cooler regions
The field stops, the heat remains

vo.text: This plate turns for a reason.
vo.speak: This plate turns for a reason.

vo.text: It helps food heat more evenly.
vo.speak: It helps food heat more evenly.

vo.text: A magnetron inside the oven generates microwaves.
vo.speak: A magnetron inside the oven generates microwaves.

vo.text: The metal walls guide and reflect them around the cavity.
vo.speak: The metal walls guide and reflect them around the cavity.

vo.text: Water molecules have uneven electrical charge, so they behave like tiny dipoles.
vo.speak: Water molecules have uneven electrical charge, so they behave like tiny dipoles.

vo.text: The changing field makes them rotate back and forth.
vo.speak: The changing field makes them rotate back and forth.

vo.text: Their motion spreads energy to nearby molecules as heat.
vo.speak: Their motion spreads energy to nearby molecules as heat.

vo.text: The oven can have hotter and cooler regions.
vo.speak: The oven can have hotter and cooler regions.

vo.text: The turntable moves food through those regions for more even heating.
vo.speak: The turntable moves food through those regions for more even heating.

vo.text: The microwaves do not make the food radioactive.
vo.speak: The microwaves do not make the food radioactive.

vo.text: Once the oven stops, the field is gone, but the heat remains.
vo.speak: Once the oven stops, the field is gone, but the heat remains.

vo.text: Microwave energy becomes molecular motion, and molecular motion becomes heat.
vo.speak: Microwave energy becomes molecular motion, and molecular motion becomes heat.
